book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: هديك الليلة، أخذني على بيت فاضي.
sentences.en: That night, he took me to an empty house.
It faced our old rooms exactly.

sentences.ar: كان بالشباك خيال راسه، من شمع.
sentences.en: In the window was the shadow of his head, made of wax.

sentences.ar: قال: السيدة هدسون بتحركه كل ربع ساعة.
sentences.en: He said: Mrs Hudson moves it every quarter of an hour.
And we wait for the one who will shoot at it.

sentences.ar: بعد ساعتين، فات رجل وفتح شباك بهدوء.
sentences.en: After two hours, a man came in and opened a window quietly.
He aimed at the shadow and fired.

sentences.ar: هولمز نط عليه، وأنا أشعلت الضوء.
sentences.en: Holmes leapt on him, and I struck a light.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز وهو ماسكه: آخر خيط بالشبكة.
sentences.en: Holmes said, holding him: the last thread in the web.

sentences.ar: وبعدين التفت عليّ وقال: يالله يا واطسون.
sentences.en: And then he turned to me and said: come, Watson.

sentences.ar: رجعنا على بيكر ستريت، وكل إشي كان زي ما تركناه.
sentences.en: We went back to Baker Street, and everything was as we had left it.
